details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. Each [swordcraft] token on your field has Rush. [fanfare] Summon a Steelclad Knight token.

issues: The passive Rush aura is encoded incorrectly with trait "swordcraft", but the source says 'Each [swordcraft] token on your field has Rush.' It should target Swordcraft token followers, e.g. auraGrantKeyword with an implementation that filters by cardClass "sword" and printingType "token" (not trait "swordcraft").

details.effect: Each [swordcraft] token on your field has Rush. On Evolve - Summon a Steelclad Knight token. Give each Steelclad Knight on your field [attack]+1/[defense]+1.

issues: The passive Rush aura is encoded incorrectly with trait "swordcraft", but the source says 'Each [swordcraft] token on your field has Rush.' It should target Swordcraft token followers, e.g. auraGrantKeyword with an implementation that filters by cardClass "sword" and printingType "token" (not trait "swordcraft").

The On Evolve buff is encoded incorrectly with buffFieldTrait using trait "Steelclad Knight". 'Give each Steelclad Knight on your field [attack]+1/[defense]+1' should target cards by name/identity, not by trait. It should be encoded as a field buff filtered to Steelclad Knight tokens/name; engine should support buffing field cards by identityName or cardNo.
